caption: The drawing features a vertically oriented rectangular frame positioned centrally on a plain beige background. The frame itself is decorated with intricate golden designs, including floral and leaf motifs. At the top center of the frame, a symmetrical arrangement of stylized leaves and a floral finial extends upwards, with small golden flowers attached to curved stems on either side. Garlands of flowers and ribbons drape downward from the top corners of the frame, each ending with small tassel-like ornaments. At the bottom of the frame, another symmetrical leafy design extends down, with additional garland elements curving outwards and ending in tassels. The interior of the frame contains a light blue, slightly shaded area, suggesting a placeholder or reflective surface. The drawing is bordered by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular outline, and in the lower right corner, the artist's name "N. Soik" is inscribed.
title: Mirror
